A formatted capacity table

Source: R/summarise.R
capacity_table.Rd

Formats a summary as a gt table, with readable numbers, a title and a source note stating what the figures are. Without the gt package, returns the formatted data frame.

Usage

capacity_table(x, title = NULL, ...)

Arguments

x

A summary from summarise_capacity() (or a capacity result, summarised by zone).

title

Optional title; default names the scenario.

...

Passed to summarise_capacity() when x is a capacity result.

Value

A gt_tbl, or a data frame.

Examples

town <- exampleton()
sc <- scenario("Operative", rulebook_example("exampleton"),
               parcels = town$parcels[town$parcels$parcel_type == "land", ],
               roads = town$parcels[town$parcels$parcel_type == "road", ],
               zoning = town$zoning, layers = town[c("height_areas", "transit")])
capacity_table(estimate_capacity(sc))
